# exo_report_submission_rule (Resource)

Manages the ReportSubmissionRule object via New-ReportSubmissionRule / Get-ReportSubmissionRule / Set-ReportSubmissionRule / Remove-ReportSubmissionRule.

## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Maps to the -Name parameter.
- `report_submission_policy` (String) Maps to the -ReportSubmissionPolicy parameter.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Maps to the -Enabled parameter.
